svg.title: Parakeet Communities — Full Rehab Lifecycle Swimlane
svg.desc: Six-lane swimlane covering all three disposition paths: Rehab (Path A), Sell As-Is (Path B), and Demo + Infill (Path C).
svg.text: Full Rehab Lifecycle — TBD Call to Market Release · Process Owner: Operations
Phase 1 — Vacancy & TBD Call (applies to all paths)
TBD Call attendees: Asset Management · Operations · Regional Manager · Sales · Construction (advisory)
Operations takes ownership of Path A the moment the rehab decision is made.
Asset Management opens RM issues and changes listing status before any path work begins.
Path A — Rehab Home · Owner: Operations (full process)
Confirm kickoff; log date in RM
Phase 3A — Operations Closeout & Market Release (1-week target from punchlist walk to listing)
Record date in RM — clock starts
All steps — punchlist walk, deficiency resolution, re-walks, Regional Manager approval, listing activation
must be completed within one week. Operations is the sole authority to extend the deadline.
Assign to Maintenance; track in RM
Confirm Regional Mgr has punch list
and RM notes; confirms standards met
Path B — Sell As-Is · Operations coordinates clean-up; Sales leads sale
No rehab issues opened in RM
Path C — Demo + Infill · Construction leads through COI; then Operations owns Path A
Construction notifies Operations: COI obtained — Construction's role ends here
Directs scope prep → Path A Phase 2A
Parakeet Communities, LLC · Confidential Internal Document · Not for External Distribution
Process Owner: Operations · Status: DRAFT — Pending Approval
